messages:
Maya (Product): Kicking off the live all-hands thread on GTM/pipeline/partners Qs. Leadership here: @Sanjay, @Devon, @Eloise — feel free to jump in. Drop one question per message so we can triage.

Devon (Sales): Quick one — which deals count as 'partner-led' for our FY26 quota? Is it only sourced from a partner referral or any co-sell where partner appears on the contract?

Eloise (Partnerships): Short answer: partner-led = partner-sourced (introduced & owns >50% of the pipeline motion). Co-sell = joint motion (we still credit partner visibility). We'll push the org doc and definition later today.

Rachel (Sales Ops): Follow-up: does partner-led still get accelerated quota credit this quarter? cc: @Devon

Sanjay (CEO): Yes — for Q1 FY26 we keep the accelerated credit for verified partner-sourced deals. We want to incentivize early partner motions during ramp; we'll review after Q1.

Devon (Sales): Thanks. Another: what's the leadership ask on average sales cycle reduction target vs prior year? We need a hard % to plan hiring.

Sanjay (CEO): Target: reduce median ACV sales cycle by 20% YoY. Operational levers: more product-led touchpoints, partner enablement, dedicated AE coverage for high-touch accounts.

Samir (Engineering): Quick tech question from the infra side: do we need to prioritize an on-prem connector for partners to run demos? Some integrations are blocked by lack of a lightweight dev image.

Eloise (Partnerships): Yes — partners asked for a dev-friendly on-prem eval image. Target: lightweight V1 in 8 weeks, full private package in 12–14 weeks. I'll coordinate with Eng and Product to scope.

Samir (Engineering): That timeline works if we reserve a 2-week engineering sprint after this release. Is prioritization approved?

Maya (Product): We can reprioritize the roadmap to bump the dev image. Ops: move 'batch inference export' months if needed. Will sync with Eng leads in PM office hours.

Rachel (Sales Ops): On metrics: can leadership confirm which pipeline signal we should use for GTM motions? 'Partner introduced' vs 'Partner engaged' — one is more reliable for reporting.

Sanjay (CEO): Use 'partner introduced' as the canonical pipeline flag for attribution. 'Partner engaged' is useful for ops but not for quota crediting. We'll update SFDC picklists.

Eloise (Partnerships): We'll publish updated partner pipeline fields + a quick Google Form for retroactive tagging on large deals. Also assembling a partner enablement kit (sales play, demo script, tech checklist).

Devon (Sales): Last one: any update on marketplace/partner portal launch timeline? Several prospects asked specifically about referral links and lead routing.

Maya (Product): Marketplace MVP targeted in 10 weeks (listings + referral links). Portal (partner dashboard + lead delivery) in 18–20 weeks. We'll post a public roadmap doc and example partner listing.

ops-bot: Reminder: All-hands follow-up doc uploaded -> /docs/all-hands/g2m-q1-summary.pdf

Sanjay (CEO): Thanks everyone. I'll host a 30-min follow-up next Wed to convert open items into owners and timelines. If you want to add to the agenda, drop a note here or DM me. :+1:
